raw_airport_passenger_events.description: Passenger events as uncompressed newline-delimited JSON under raw/airports/passenger_events/dt=YYYY-MM-DD/. dt is the flight operating day. A cabin sample, not a full manifest.

partition_keys.name: dt
partition_keys.comment: Flight operating day, yyyy-MM-dd, taken from the directory dt=YYYY-MM-DD. Not a field inside the JSON line. Projection type is date.

columns.name: schema_version
columns.comment: Contract version. The JSON Schema requires 1.

columns.name: event_id
columns.comment: Unique id of this event.

columns.name: event_type
columns.comment: Kind of event. The allowed values are in the JSON Schema.

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.comment: When the event happened, ISO-8601 UTC text. Not a timestamp column.

columns.name: passenger_id
columns.comment: Synthetic passenger id. Classic rows use 7 digits. Mega rows use 8.

columns.name: passenger_name
columns.comment: Two fictional words. No document number, email, or date of birth.

columns.name: flight_id
columns.comment: Stable flight id. Includes the scheduled date, flight number, origin, and scheduled destination.

columns.name: airline_iata
columns.comment: Airline IATA code.

columns.name: origin_iata
columns.comment: Origin airport IATA code.

columns.name: destination_iata
columns.comment: Destination IATA code on this row. A diversion keeps the departure destination on passenger rows.

columns.name: bags
columns.comment: Checked bags on this passenger event. Zero when none were dropped.

columns.name: seat
columns.comment: Seat such as 12A. Null when the passenger has no seat.

raw_airport_flight_events.description: Flight lifecycle events as uncompressed newline-delimited JSON under raw/airports/flight_events/dt=YYYY-MM-DD/. dt is the flight operating day. flight_id stays the same after a reroute.

partition_keys.name: dt
partition_keys.comment: Flight operating day, yyyy-MM-dd, taken from the directory dt=YYYY-MM-DD. Not a field inside the JSON line. Projection type is date.

columns.name: schema_version
columns.comment: Contract version. The JSON Schema requires 1.

columns.name: event_id
columns.comment: Unique id of this event.

columns.name: event_type
columns.comment: Kind of event. The allowed values are in the JSON Schema.

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.comment: When the event happened, ISO-8601 UTC text. Not a timestamp column.

columns.name: flight_id
columns.comment: Stable flight id. Includes the scheduled date, flight number, origin, and scheduled destination.

columns.name: flight_number
columns.comment: Airline code plus four digits. Mega reuses the number on later days. flight_id carries the date.

columns.name: airline_iata
columns.comment: Airline IATA code.

columns.name: tail_number
columns.comment: Synthetic tail. T- plus the airline code and four digits. Not an FAA registration.

columns.name: aircraft_type
columns.comment: ICAO type designator, for example B738.

columns.name: origin_iata
columns.comment: Origin airport IATA code.

columns.name: origin_icao
columns.comment: Origin airport ICAO code.

columns.name: destination_iata
columns.comment: Destination IATA code on this row. A diversion keeps the departure destination on passenger rows.

columns.name: destination_icao
columns.comment: Destination ICAO code on this row.

columns.name: scheduled_departure_at
columns.comment: Scheduled off-block time, ISO-8601 UTC text.

columns.name: scheduled_arrival_at
columns.comment: Scheduled arrival published on this event, ISO-8601 UTC text.

columns.name: delay_minutes
columns.comment: Off-block slip against scheduled_departure_at, in minutes.

columns.name: delay_reason
columns.comment: Why the flight is delayed, cancelled, or rerouted. Null on a plain scheduled event.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Status after this event.

columns.name: previous_destination_iata
columns.comment: Destination before a reroute. Null when the destination did not change.

columns.name: alternate_iata
columns.comment: Nearest other airport to the destination on this event.

columns.name: route
columns.comment: Origin ICAO, DCT, destination ICAO.

columns.name: weather_report_id
columns.comment: Weather observation used by this row. wx_ plus ICAO and YYYYMMDDHH.

raw_airport_fuel_records.description: Fuel plans and revisions as uncompressed newline-delimited JSON under raw/airports/fuel_records/dt=YYYY-MM-DD/. Kilograms and nautical miles are decimal strings. dt is the flight operating day.

partition_keys.name: dt
partition_keys.comment: Flight operating day, yyyy-MM-dd, taken from the directory dt=YYYY-MM-DD. Not a field inside the JSON line. Projection type is date.

columns.name: schema_version
columns.comment: Contract version. The JSON Schema requires 1.

columns.name: event_id
columns.comment: Unique id of this event.

columns.name: event_type
columns.comment: Kind of event. The allowed values are in the JSON Schema.

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.comment: When the event happened, ISO-8601 UTC text. Not a timestamp column.

columns.name: flight_id
columns.comment: Stable flight id. Includes the scheduled date, flight number, origin, and scheduled destination.

columns.name: tail_number
columns.comment: Synthetic tail. T- plus the airline code and four digits. Not an FAA registration.

columns.name: aircraft_type
columns.comment: ICAO type designator, for example B738.

columns.name: stage
columns.comment: preflight or airborne.

columns.name: origin_iata
columns.comment: Origin airport IATA code.

columns.name: origin_icao
columns.comment: Origin airport ICAO code.

columns.name: destination_iata
columns.comment: Destination IATA code on this row. A diversion keeps the departure destination on passenger rows.

columns.name: destination_icao
columns.comment: Destination ICAO code on this row.

columns.name: previous_destination_iata
columns.comment: Destination before a reroute. Null when the destination did not change.

columns.name: alternate_iata
columns.comment: Nearest other airport to the destination on this event.

columns.name: alternate_icao
columns.comment: ICAO code of the alternate airport.

columns.name: distance_nm
columns.comment: Stage length in nautical miles, decimal string.

columns.name: course_deg
columns.comment: Initial course in degrees.

columns.name: cruise_tas_kt
columns.comment: Cruise true airspeed in knots.

columns.name: wind_dir_deg
columns.comment: Wind direction in degrees, the direction it comes from.

columns.name: wind_speed_kt
columns.comment: Wind speed in knots.

columns.name: wind_component_kt
columns.comment: Headwind along the course. A tailwind is negative.

columns.name: ground_speed_kt
columns.comment: Cruise true airspeed minus the headwind, never below 220.

columns.name: burn_kg_per_hour
columns.comment: Planning fuel flow, decimal string of kilograms per hour.

columns.name: trip_minutes
columns.comment: Planned airborne minutes.

columns.name: trip_fuel_kg
columns.comment: Trip fuel, decimal string of kilograms.

columns.name: taxi_fuel_kg
columns.comment: Taxi fuel, decimal string of kilograms. Zero on an airborne revision.

columns.name: contingency_rate
columns.comment: Contingency fraction. This model uses 0.05.

columns.name: contingency_fuel_kg
columns.comment: Contingency fuel, decimal string of kilograms.

columns.name: alternate_distance_nm
columns.comment: Distance from the destination to the alternate, decimal string of nautical miles.

columns.name: alternate_fuel_kg
columns.comment: Alternate fuel, decimal string of kilograms.

columns.name: reserve_minutes
columns.comment: Planning reserve in minutes.

columns.name: reserve_fuel_kg
columns.comment: Reserve fuel, decimal string of kilograms.

columns.name: burn_so_far_kg
columns.comment: Fuel already burned, decimal string of kilograms.

columns.name: planned_fuel_kg
columns.comment: Planned fuel, decimal string of kilograms.

columns.name: extra_fuel_kg
columns.comment: Extra uplift, decimal string of kilograms.

columns.name: uplift_kg
columns.comment: Fuel uplifted, decimal string of kilograms. Zero when the flight is cancelled.

columns.name: estimated_burn_kg
columns.comment: Estimated burn, decimal string of kilograms.

columns.name: remaining_fuel_kg
columns.comment: Uplift minus estimated burn, decimal string of kilograms.

columns.name: decision_fraction
columns.comment: Fraction of the planned leg already flown when the fuel figure was made.

columns.name: weather_report_id
columns.comment: Weather observation used by this row. wx_ plus ICAO and YYYYMMDDHH.

columns.name: reroute_event_id
columns.comment: FlightRerouted event this revision belongs to. Null on the original plan.

raw_airport_weather_reports.description: Hourly airport observations as uncompressed newline-delimited JSON under raw/airports/weather_reports/dt=YYYY-MM-DD/. dt is the operating day that wrote the file. Not a copy of a live METAR feed.

partition_keys.name: dt
partition_keys.comment: Flight operating day, yyyy-MM-dd, taken from the directory dt=YYYY-MM-DD. Not a field inside the JSON line. Projection type is date.

columns.name: schema_version
columns.comment: Contract version. The JSON Schema requires 1.

columns.name: report_id
columns.comment: Weather report id. wx_ plus ICAO and YYYYMMDDHH.

columns.name: airport_iata
columns.comment: Airport IATA code.

columns.name: airport_icao
columns.comment: Airport ICAO code.

columns.name: observed_at
columns.comment: Observation time, ISO-8601 UTC text, on the hour.

columns.name: wind_dir_deg
columns.comment: Wind direction in degrees, the direction it comes from.

columns.name: wind_speed_kt
columns.comment: Wind speed in knots.

columns.name: wind_gust_kt
columns.comment: Gust speed in knots. Null when there is no gust.

columns.name: visibility_sm
columns.comment: Visibility in statute miles, one decimal.

columns.name: ceiling_ft
columns.comment: Ceiling in feet. Null when the ceiling is unlimited.

columns.name: precip
columns.comment: none, rain, snow, or thunderstorm.

columns.name: temp_c
columns.comment: Temperature in Celsius, one decimal.

columns.name: dewpoint_c
columns.comment: Dewpoint in Celsius, one decimal. At or below the temperature.

columns.name: altimeter_inhg
columns.comment: Altimeter setting in inches of mercury.

columns.name: flight_category
columns.comment: VFR, MVFR, IFR, or LIFR, derived from ceiling and visibility.

columns.name: airport_closed
columns.comment: True when the airport is closed in this observation.

raw_airport_airports.description: Airport reference extract as uncompressed newline-delimited JSON under raw/airports/reference/airports/. Not partitioned. The original 22 codes are public. The Z-codes are synthetic.

columns.name: schema_version
columns.comment: Contract version. The JSON Schema requires 1.

columns.name: iata
columns.comment: IATA code.

columns.name: icao
columns.comment: ICAO code.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Display name.

columns.name: city
columns.comment: City the field stands in for. Synthetic fields are not the real airport.

columns.name: latitude
columns.comment: Latitude, four decimal places.

columns.name: longitude
columns.comment: Longitude, four decimal places.

columns.name: elevation_ft
columns.comment: Field elevation in feet.

raw_airport_airlines.description: Airline reference extract as uncompressed newline-delimited JSON under raw/airports/reference/airlines/. Not partitioned.
